subject: general
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af9785ab11eb0bff484889438edc09b2096e268fc897c78b71a233f86153d94c.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

1) Black coloured one square in first figure, then one circle added in second figure, then one black coloured one square added in third figure, then again one circle added in fourth figure and finally black coloured square added in the final figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c7222777954319d9660358c51039e96d83143c35c46d4c8fbfa1ccc58266f504.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
